test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Mita is __smart__ than many other kids in the school.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is comparing Mita with many other kids, which requires the comparative form of the adjective "smart".
 
• The correct comparative form of "smart" is "smarter", not "smart".
 
• Thus, the segment "smart" needs to be substituted with "smarter".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mita is smarter than many other kids in the school."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "most smart"** – This is incorrect because "most smart" is not a correct comparative form; the superlative form of "smart" is "smartest".
 
• **2: "less smart"** – This is incorrect because it implies that Mita is not as smart as many other kids, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• **3: "smartest"** – This is incorrect because "smartest" is the superlative form, used to compare one entity to all others in a group, not in a comparative sense between two.
